scope: One cover sentence explicitly restores the already accepted nonsingular group-closure premise and includes the identity ordinary kernel. Mathematical theorem/review/checker bytes unchanged. Singular completed-forest idempotents are not subject to this group theorem.

 1. [Ordered independent closure](ORDERED-INDEPENDENT-CLOSURE.md). Every actual independent-chain closure kernel with positive pair survival has a chronological representation by finite or countably many closed-parameter bigon operations, with ordinary Kingman evolution between them. The full forest error after retaining the N largest-cost jumps in their ORIGINAL order is at most D_m h sqrt(h/(N+1)). The representation includes higher-copy singular limits and does not make endpoint populations physical.
 2. [Three-lineage survival control](THREE-LINEAGE-SURVIVAL-CONTROL.md). For k>=3, lambda=binom(k,2), all finite independent chains and their capped closures satisfy b_k>=b_3^(6lambda²+lambda). Thus positive b3 controls all higher diagonals in the declared cap. Only three diagonal-zero patterns can occur; these are not a classification of numerical matrix ranks.
-3. [Infinitesimal-factorization obstruction](INDEPENDENT-INFINITESIMAL-OBSTRUCTION.md). The actual independent closure has only the ordinary Kingman infinitesimal ray. Unbounded source-root orders or arbitrarily fine source factorizations occur exactly for ordinary edges, while actual positive bigons supply nonordinary kernels. Finite bigon operations cannot be discarded by invoking an infinitesimal control description.
+3. [Infinitesimal-factorization obstruction](INDEPENDENT-INFINITESIMAL-OBSTRUCTION.md). The actual independent closure has only the ordinary Kingman infinitesimal ray. Within the NONSINGULAR source-group closure, unbounded source-root orders or arbitrarily fine source factorizations occur exactly for ordinary kernels (including the identity), while actual positive bigons supply nonordinary kernels. Finite bigon operations cannot be discarded by invoking an infinitesimal control description.
 
 These statements use the already accepted G6 weak-bigon approximation and projectivity, with attribution. They do not claim to introduce that approximation theorem.
